slide.text: How government and stakeholders capture value
The platform creates economic value differently for federal institutions, state land agencies, and builders, while also improving transparency for NGOs and confidence for end buyers.

The right question is not only whether the platform digitizes workflow. The right question is how it helps public institutions capture more revenue and trust, and how it helps builders and market actors lower delay cost, reduce risk, and convert projects faster.

tr.td: More traceable permits, fees, and strategic approvals support stronger national oversight and less leakage.
Clearer approval records, formalisation signals, and land-linked workflows improve internally generated revenue visibility.
Faster approvals and fewer stalled files reduce carrying cost and improve project cash-flow timing.
Better governance signals improve confidence in strategic sectors such as housing, mining, and energy.
More credible state delivery makes land and infrastructure projects easier to attract capital into.
Shorter cycle times improve bankability, partner confidence, and route-to-market predictability.
Signed audits, public verification, and custody controls reduce dispute and reputational risk.
Supervisor visibility and workflow traceability reduce informal bottlenecks and service opacity.
Stronger parcel, permit, and title continuity lowers due-diligence risk and rework risk.
Queue oversight and exception analytics help leadership intervene before delays become systemic.
State teams can move C of O, planning, and land workflows with clearer queue ownership and escalation controls.
Project teams spend less time chasing status across agencies and more time delivering sites and units.
Institutional credibility improves when external parties can verify records and audit packages independently.
Better records strengthen the credibility of state land administration and citizen-facing service delivery.
More trusted records support buyer uptake, lender comfort, and downstream sales conversion.

slide.text: NGOs gain stronger transparency and accountability evidence, while end buyers gain confidence that land, title, and permit records align before they commit capital.
